Tcl/Tk 8.6.14 script libraries: https://github.com/tcltk/tcl/tree/core-8-6-14/library and https://github.com/tcltk/tk/tree/core-8-6-14/library
8.6.15 script libraries: bundled with the build Python distribution.
Original license.terms files are included. Only scripts matching the loaded Tcl DLL patch version are used as fallback.
